title.value: Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Chemicals Consumer Protection Law
title.provenance: Provides that the amendatory Act may be referred to as the Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Chemicals Consumer Protection Law.

pfas_definition.provenance: "PFAS chemical" means any of the perfluoroalkyl substances or polyfluoroalkyl substances included in the United States Environmental Protection Agency's expanded ToxCast chemical inventory.

type.provenance: Environmentally preferable supplies ... do not contain intentionally added PFAS chemicals

who.provenance: State agencies shall contract for supplies and services that are environmentally preferable.

products.provenance: Environmentally preferable supplies ... Environmentally preferable services

type.provenance: no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use ... if the product contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical
